purpose: Classical RGB-only unknown-intrinsics reference on all three fixed TUM sequences; attempt 7 of 8, not an agent A/B or SOTA comparison
readiness_rule: One connected reconstruction with all six predeclared frames registered and at least 100 triangulated points
geometric_threshold_policy: Keep installed 4.2.0 geometric defaults; serialize effective options in every result
unregistered_frame_policy: Retain missing IDs and fail initialization readiness; no resampling or per-frame best-model stitching
coordinate_policy: Arbitrary SfM similarity gauge. No inferred metric scale or gravity alignment is declared measured.
protocol_note: New controlled pair: both arms fix two-view RANSAC seed, previously left at library default -1. Earlier receipts retained; do not attribute their differing registrations to feature cap.
input_policy: Only unchanged six RGB images per source; no GT, depth or supplied intrinsics in initializer. Same unknown-intrinsics SIMPLE_PINHOLE and all numeric parameters as frozen sfm_init_005.
evaluation_policy: After prediction freeze, use all six original RGB timestamps and translation-only Sim3 ATE against mocap with existing 20ms matcher. Withhold full ATE if any prediction is missing. Scale fitted to GT for evaluation only; unscaled SE3 is not a physical metre error here.
